concept: Protecting time and energy for curiosity amid the demands of adult responsibility
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic scenario where work and family demands have crowded out any space for personal curiosity or learning
exercise.reflection_prompt: What would it actually take to protect even a small amount of space for this?
exercise.practice: Adult identifies one small, realistic change to make room for a personal interest

assessment.success_marker: adult proposes a specific, realistic (not aspirational-only) change
